import os import shutil import tempfile import zipfile import pandas as pd import plotly.graph_objects as go import rainbow # rainbow-api from shiny import App, Inputs, Outputs, Session, reactive, render, ui from shinywidgets import output_widget, render_plotly # ============================================================================== # UI DEFINITION # ============================================================================== app_ui = ui.page_fluid( ui.panel_title("HPLC-DAD Interactive Explorer"), ui.layout_sidebar( ui.sidebar( ui.h4("1. Upload & Load Data"), ui.input_file("dx_file", "Upload .dx File:", accept=[".dx"]), ui.output_text_verbatim("datadir_output"), ui.hr(), ui.h4("2. Select Datafile"), ui.input_select("uv_file_select", "Select Datafile (.UV):", choices=[]), width=350, ), # Layout: Main Heatmap (Top Left), UV-Vis Spectrum (Top Right), HPLC Trace (Bottom, full width) ui.layout_columns( ui.card( ui.card_header("HPLC-DAD Absorbance Heatmap (Click to inspect)"), output_widget("heatmap_plot"), ui.download_button("download_heatmap_csv", "Download Heatmap Data (CSV)"), ), ui.card( ui.card_header("UV-Vis Spectrum at Selected Time"), ui.input_numeric("select_time", "Or enter retention time (min):", value=None, step=0.01), output_widget("uvvis_plot"), ui.output_text_verbatim("uvvis_selected_info"), ui.download_button("download_uvvis_csv", "Download UV-Vis Data (CSV)"), ), col_widths=(8, 4), ), ui.layout_columns( ui.card( ui.card_header("HPLC Trace at Selected Wavelength"), ui.input_numeric("select_wavelength", "Or enter wavelength (nm):", value=None, step=0.1), output_widget("hplc_plot"), ui.output_text_verbatim("hplc_selected_info"), ui.download_button("download_hplc_csv", "Download HPLC Data (CSV)"), ), col_widths=(8,), ), ), ) # ============================================================================== # SERVER LOGIC # ============================================================================== def server(input: Inputs, output: Outputs, session: Session): # Reactive values to hold click-selection state selected_retention_time = reactive.value(None) selected_wavelength = reactive.value(None) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 1. READ .dx FILE # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- load_error = reactive.value(None) @reactive.calc def loaded_datadir(): file_info = input.dx_file() if not file_info: load_error.set(None) return None # `datapath` is already a path to the uploaded bytes on disk (or in the # Pyodide virtual FS under shinylive). Copy it to a path that keeps the # original filename/extension, since rainbow infers the vendor format # from the ".dx" suffix. try: upload_path = file_info[0]["datapath"] orig_name = file_info[0]["name"] if orig_name.lower().endswith(".dx"): # .dx is a zip archive of the .D folder. The installed # rainbow-api build doesn't always auto-detect/unzip .dx # itself, so extract it ourselves and point rainbow at the # resulting directory. extract_root = tempfile.mkdtemp() with zipfile.ZipFile(upload_path, "r") as zf: zf.extractall(extract_root) entries = [ e for e in os.listdir(extract_root) if not e.startswith("__MACOSX") ] subdirs = [e for e in entries if os.path.isdir(os.path.join(extract_root, e))] if len(subdirs) == 1 and subdirs[0].lower().endswith(".d"): datadir_path = os.path.join(extract_root, subdirs[0]) else: datadir_path = extract_root else: # Already a directory-like upload (e.g. individual file); keep # the original filename/extension since rainbow uses it. temp_dir = tempfile.mkdtemp() datadir_path = os.path.join(temp_dir, orig_name) shutil.copy(upload_path, datadir_path) datadir = rainbow.agilent.read(datadir_path) load_error.set(None) return datadir except Exception: import traceback load_error.set(traceback.format_exc()) return None @render.text def datadir_output(): err = load_error() if err: return f"Error loading file:\n{err}" datadir = loaded_datadir() if datadir is None: return "Please upload a .dx file to begin." return str(datadir) # Reset selections and populate the datafile dropdown whenever a new .dx is loaded @reactive.effect def update_file_choices(): datadir = loaded_datadir() selected_retention_time.set(None) selected_wavelength.set(None) if datadir is None: ui.update_select("uv_file_select", choices=[]) return names = [n for n in datadir.by_name.keys() if n.lower().endswith(".uv")] ui.update_select("uv_file_select", choices=names, selected=names[0] if names else None) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 2. LOAD SELECTED DATAFILE # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @reactive.calc def loaded_datafile(): datadir = loaded_datadir() selected_file = input.uv_file_select() if datadir is None or not selected_file: return None datafile = datadir.get_file(selected_file) # Default the click-selection to the center of the dataset if selected_retention_time() is None: selected_retention_time.set(datafile.xlabels[len(datafile.xlabels) // 2]) if selected_wavelength() is None: selected_wavelength.set(datafile.ylabels[len(datafile.ylabels) // 2]) return datafile # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 3. HEATMAP PLOT (clickable) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @render_plotly def heatmap_plot(): datafile = loaded_datafile() if datafile is None: return go.FigureWidget() fig = go.FigureWidget( data=go.Heatmap( x=datafile.xlabels, y=datafile.ylabels, z=datafile.data.T, colorscale="Viridis", colorbar=dict(title="Absorbance (mAU)"), hovertemplate="Time: %{x:.2f} min
Wavelength: %{y:.1f} nm
Absorbance: %{z:.4f} mAU", ) ) fig.update_layout( title="HPLC-DAD Absorbance Heatmap", xaxis_title="Retention Time (min)", yaxis_title="Wavelength (nm)", template="plotly_white", margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=40, b=40), ) def handle_click(trace, points, state): if points.xs: selected_retention_time.set(points.xs[0]) selected_wavelength.set(points.ys[0]) fig.data[0].on_click(handle_click) return fig # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 4. UV-VIS SPECTRUM PLOT (right panel) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @render_plotly def uvvis_plot(): datafile = loaded_datafile() time_val = selected_retention_time() if datafile is None or time_val is None: return go.FigureWidget() time_idx = min(range(len(datafile.xlabels)), key=lambda i: abs(datafile.xlabels[i] - time_val)) actual_time = datafile.xlabels[time_idx] spectrum = datafile.data[time_idx, :] fig = go.FigureWidget( data=go.Scatter(x=datafile.ylabels, y=spectrum, mode="lines", line=dict(color="#2b5c8f", width=2)) ) fig.update_layout( title=f"Spectrum at RT = {actual_time:.2f} min", xaxis_title="Wavelength (nm)", yaxis_title="Absorbance (mAU)", template="plotly_white", margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=40, b=40), ) return fig # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 5. HPLC TRACE PLOT (bottom panel) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @render_plotly def hplc_plot(): datafile = loaded_datafile() wl_val = selected_wavelength() if datafile is None or wl_val is None: return go.FigureWidget() wl_idx = min(range(len(datafile.ylabels)), key=lambda i: abs(datafile.ylabels[i] - wl_val)) actual_wl = datafile.ylabels[wl_idx] chromatogram = datafile.data[:, wl_idx] fig = go.FigureWidget( data=go.Scatter(x=datafile.xlabels, y=chromatogram, mode="lines", line=dict(color="#d95f02", width=2)) ) fig.update_layout( title=f"Chromatogram at λ = {actual_wl:.1f} nm", xaxis_title="Retention Time (min)", yaxis_title="Absorbance (mAU)", template="plotly_white", margin=dict(l=40, r=40, t=40, b=40), ) return fig # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # 6. CSV DOWNLOAD HANDLERS # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @render.download(filename="heatmap_matrix.csv") def download_heatmap_csv(): datafile = loaded_datafile() if datafile is None: return None df = pd.DataFrame(datafile.data, index=datafile.xlabels, columns=datafile.ylabels) df.index.name = "Time_min" yield df.to_csv() @render.download(filename="uvvis_spectrum.csv") def download_uvvis_csv(): datafile = loaded_datafile() time_val = selected_retention_time() if datafile is None or time_val is None: return None time_idx = min(range(len(datafile.xlabels)), key=lambda i: abs(datafile.xlabels[i] - time_val)) df = pd.DataFrame({"Wavelength_nm": datafile.ylabels, "Absorbance_mAU": datafile.data[time_idx, :]}) yield df.to_csv(index=False) @render.download(filename="hplc_trace.csv") def download_hplc_csv(): datafile = loaded_datafile() wl_val = selected_wavelength() if datafile is None or wl_val is None: return None wl_idx = min(range(len(datafile.ylabels)), key=lambda i: abs(datafile.ylabels[i] - wl_val)) df = pd.DataFrame({"RetentionTime_min": datafile.xlabels, "Absorbance_mAU": datafile.data[:, wl_idx]}) yield df.to_csv(index=False) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Sync: numeric inputs -> reactive selection (user typed a value) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.select_time) def _sync_time_input_to_selection(): val = input.select_time() datafile = loaded_datafile() if datafile is None or val is None: return nearest = min(datafile.xlabels, key=lambda t: abs(t - val)) if nearest != selected_retention_time(): selected_retention_time.set(nearest) @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.select_wavelength) def _sync_wavelength_input_to_selection(): val = input.select_wavelength() datafile = loaded_datafile() if datafile is None or val is None: return nearest = min(datafile.ylabels, key=lambda w: abs(w - val)) if nearest != selected_wavelength(): selected_wavelength.set(nearest) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Sync: reactive selection -> numeric inputs (e.g. after a heatmap click) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.select_time) def _sync_time_input_to_selection(): val = input.select_time() datafile = loaded_datafile() if datafile is None or val is None: return # Skip if this is just our own selection echoed back (rounded) current = selected_retention_time() if current is not None and round(current, 3) == round(val, 3): return nearest = min(datafile.xlabels, key=lambda t: abs(t - val)) if nearest != current: selected_retention_time.set(nearest) @reactive.effect @reactive.event(input.select_wavelength) def _sync_wavelength_input_to_selection(): val = input.select_wavelength() datafile = loaded_datafile() if datafile is None or val is None: return current = selected_wavelength() if current is not None and round(current, 3) == round(val, 3): return nearest = min(datafile.ylabels, key=lambda w: abs(w - val)) if nearest != current: selected_wavelength.set(nearest) # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- # Selected-value readouts # -------------------------------------------------------------------------- @render.text def uvvis_selected_info(): datafile = loaded_datafile() time_val = selected_retention_time() if datafile is None or time_val is None: return "" time_idx = min(range(len(datafile.xlabels)), key=lambda i: abs(datafile.xlabels[i] - time_val)) actual_time = datafile.xlabels[time_idx] peak_abs = datafile.data[time_idx, :].max() return ( f"Selected retention time: {actual_time:.3f} min\n" f"Peak absorbance in spectrum: {peak_abs:.4f} mAU" ) @render.text def hplc_selected_info(): datafile = loaded_datafile() wl_val = selected_wavelength() if datafile is None or wl_val is None: return "" wl_idx = min(range(len(datafile.ylabels)), key=lambda i: abs(datafile.ylabels[i] - wl_val)) actual_wl = datafile.ylabels[wl_idx] peak_abs = datafile.data[:, wl_idx].max() return ( f"Selected wavelength: {actual_wl:.2f} nm\n" f"Peak absorbance in trace: {peak_abs:.4f} mAU" ) # ============================================================================== # APP LAUNCH # ============================================================================== app = App(app_ui, server)
